requirements.description: Fixed-limit Texas Hold'em deals one authenticated human and three server-managed opponents through shared card and poker primitives with call-or-fold streets and transparent showdown settlement that rakes each pot so the table holds a house edge against best play.
requirements.notes: Server game logic owns legal turns, hidden cards, random outcomes, and payout math under SEC-003 and SEC-004. Always-play is break-even and the human can only call or fold, so best play was marginally player-positive (~101%, measured over 20k hands); a five-percent pot rake now keeps optimal play house-side (~98%) with the withheld cents the only net wallet reduction (issue #456).

requirements.description: Authenticated sessions own private reload-safe hands, decisions, compact replay receipts, settled history, and canonical route restoration without exposing active opponent cards or another user's state.
requirements.notes: Session context overrides caller player ids, hostile protected fields are removed, and authoritative refresh restores server-owned state under SEC-001, SEC-002, and SEC-009.

requirements.description: The human and all three funded opponent accounts reserve maximum exposure and receive unused escrow and pot shares only through storage-enforced ledger action identities with Admin-auditable owner context.
requirements.notes: Consumes accepted issues #190 and #189 and satisfies SEC-005 through SEC-008 without direct balance mutation.

requirements.description: Texas Hold'em Practice Table supplies complete English and Russian responsive, accessible, reduced-motion-safe, timer-clean play across all governed viewports.
requirements.notes: After-pass evidence covers both locales, every viewport, every decision street, settlement, reduced motion, route restoration, and authoritative refresh after client tampering.

requirements.description: Catalog, contract, browser, restart, long-suite, funded-opponent, version, requirement, visual, and hostile-client certification evidence remains traceable for Texas Hold'em Practice Table.
requirements.notes: Descriptor sort order 200 and every mutation action are included in the accepted SEC-001 through SEC-009 certification matrix.

requirements.description: Practice-table hands pre-flight every seat's reserved solvency before any persistence or debit, compensate each committed escrow exactly once when reconciliation fails, and self-heal a stranded prepared hand on the next request, so bot-wallet exhaustion can neither brick the table nor strand player escrow.
requirements.notes: Compensation uses the established escrow-refund vocabulary per seat and poisons the originating request receipt so an exact retry fails closed instead of replaying refunded escrow as live.
